URL: https://www.atlanticcouncil.org/blogs/new-atlanticist/experts-react/experts-react-what-does-the-trump-xi-meeting-mean-for-trade-technology-security-and-beyond/

Atlantic Council expert reactions to Trump-Xi summit:

Named expert quotes:
- Markus Garlauskas (Director, Indo-Pacific Security Initiative) on Xi-Taiwan leverage: "Taiwan is Taiwan" dismissively, suggesting Xi realized he lacked leverage to extract concessions
- Josh Lipsky (Chair of International Economics): "a trade truce is likely the best either side can hope for in the near future"
- Matthew Kroenig (VP, Scowcroft Center): "expect the bilateral relationship to get worse before it gets better"
- Melanie Hart (Senior Director, Global China Hub): China is "using an extraordinary line up of pre-scheduled 2026 meetings to box him in"
- Jeremy Mark (Nonresident Senior Fellow): Beijing has "tremendous advantages in the ongoing negotiations"

Analysis focused on trade, technology, Taiwan, security; less on Iran/Hormuz specifically.
